chunks: And ʿAlī عليه السلام recited twenty-five takbirs over Sahl ibn Ḥunayf.

key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةً: a single takbir utterance in the funeral prayer
key_terms.حُنَيْفٍ: the family name of Sahl ibn Ḥunayf
key_terms.سَهْلِ: Sahl, the deceased being prayed over
key_terms.عِشْرِينَ: twenty, forming the number twenty-five with five
key_terms.كَبَّرَ: pronounced the takbir in the funeral prayer

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام recite over Sahl ibn Ḥunayf in the funeral prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام performed the funeral prayer over Sahl ibn Ḥunayf with twenty-five takbirs. It reflects a historical report connected to salat al-janazah and indicates a distinctive practice in this particular funeral.
